'''Fudbalski klub BSK Banja Luka''' ({{lang-sr-Cyrl|Фудбалски клуб БCK Бања Лука}}) is a professional [[association football]] club from the city of [[Banja Luka]] that is situated in [[Bosnia and Herzegovina]]. They play in the [[Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina]].

''BSK'' stands for ''Banjalučki sportski klub'' meaning "Sports Society of Banja Luka"."}}
